ModBellUrchin.name: Bell Urchin
ModBellUrchin.attack: Curl up and roll at the hero; may bleed
ModBellUrchin.special: Fire a ring of spines all round you
passive: In brine your tube feet grip: no knockback

ModLurefish.name: Lurefish
ModLurefish.attack: Snap forward and bite, short range
ModLurefish.special: Cast your lure: tug the hero in, then bite
passive: Hold back: a brighter lure tugs from further away

ModBarnacleCrab.name: Barnacle Crab
ModBarnacleCrab.special: Shell up and gain a plate
passive: You scuttle sideways faster: circle in

ModBellDiver.name: Bell Diver
ModBellDiver.attack: Anchor slam; a quake ring ahead knocks back
ModBellDiver.special: Chain hook: reels the hero in on a hit
passive: A missed hook anchors: you haul yourself to it

ModSpinewalker.name: Spinewalker
ModSpinewalker.attack: Spear the floor just ahead with a stilt
ModSpinewalker.special: Drop spined eggs that burst as he nears
passive: Your eggs drift after the hero in brine
ModSpinewalker.vault: An urchin up on four tall spines. Its eggs float after you through the brine

ModSaltSiren.name: Salt Siren
ModSaltSiren.attack: Water bolt, long range; may slow
ModSaltSiren.special: Song: tug the hero to you, brine wells under him
passive: Your song drags nearby brine pools to the hero

ModBrineLamprey.name: Brine Lamprey
passive: A lunge that lands latches on, then rasps again

ModBellHermit.name: Bell Hermit
ModBellHermit.attack: Lunging claw crush with big knockback
ModBellHermit.special: Bell down: take far less damage, hits ring out
passive: Brine fills your bell; Bell Down pours it out

ModAnemoneBoxer.name: Anemone Boxer
ModAnemoneBoxer.attack: One-two punch with anemone gloves; may poison
passive: After every punch you hop back out of reach
ModAnemoneBoxer.vault: A crab that boxes with a stinging anemone on each claw. It hops back after every punch

ModDrownedBell.name: The Drowned Bell
ModDrownedBell.attack: Toll: a heavy ring just ahead; may stun
ModDrownedBell.special: Cast the Bell at the hero; it lands in brine
passive: Bell off: faster, but hits hurt more

ModDrownedCaptain.name: Drowned Captain
ModDrownedCaptain.attack: Gaff slash that hauls the hero in; may bleed
ModDrownedCaptain.special: Grapple Swing: swing across (can't be hit), boot
passive: A hero you haul or kick into brine is held under

ModCrownOfThorns.name: Crown of Thorns
ModCrownOfThorns.attack: Lash an arm down ahead; may bleed
ModCrownOfThorns.special: Fling a thorn per arm left; they stick and bleed
passive: Broken-off arms crawl to brine and regrow
ModCrownOfThorns.vault: A spined starfish walking on two arms. Its broken arms crawl to the brine and grow back

ModBroodUrchin.name: Brood Urchin
ModBroodUrchin.attack: Spit a fan of three spines
ModBroodUrchin.special: Lob eggs that burst when the tide comes
passive: When the tide comes in, every egg bursts in spines
ModBroodUrchin.vault: A bloated urchin queen. Her eggs sit on the floor and burst when the tide comes in

ModTideMatriarch.name: Tide Matriarch
ModTideMatriarch.attack: Trident thrust that also flings a coral shard
ModTideMatriarch.special: Riptide Lanes: currents from brine carry him to you
passive: No brine near? You call the tide in early

ModJellySiren.name: Jelly Siren
ModJellySiren.special: Jet Pulse: circle the hero, leaving sting rings
passive: Your long tentacles trail behind: they sting
ModJellySiren.vault: The siren grew a jellyfish bell. Her stinging tentacles trail far behind her

ModGulperEel.name: Gulper Eel
ModGulperEel.special: Unhinge, then swallow the hero whole and spit him
ModGulperEel.vault: A pelican eel that is all jaw. It swallows you whole, and its full throat is soft

ModSlimeHag.name: Slime Hag
ModSlimeHag.attack: Rasping bite that ties you in a knot
ModSlimeHag.special: Spew slime that slows the hero's shots
passive: A bite that lands twists into a second bite
ModSlimeHag.vault: An eyeless hagfish tied in a knot. Its slime gums up your weapons

ModAbyssKraken.name: Abyss Kraken
ModAbyssKraken.attack: Two arms slam the floor ahead; may slow
ModAbyssKraken.special: Arms burst under the hero and from brine; they root
passive: With three arms up, your head is open

ModBelltowerHermit.name: Belltower Hermit
ModBelltowerHermit.attack: Crusher claw snap with big knockback
ModBelltowerHermit.special: Five peals march out to the hero; may stun
passive: A peal in brine rings through it: stuns all in it
ModBelltowerHermit.vault: A hermit crab carrying a drowned bell tower. Its peals ring through the brine

ModAnemoneColossus.name: Anemone Colossus
ModAnemoneColossus.attack: Both pincers hammer the floor ahead
ModAnemoneColossus.special: Flick two anemone buds by the hero: they sting
passive: In brine your garden opens and stings all round
ModAnemoneColossus.vault: A crab so old its shell is a garden of anemones. In the brine they open and sting

ModReefChampion.name: Reef Champion
ModReefChampion.attack: Rising uppercut with a club fist
ModReefChampion.special: Haymaker: wind up, one punch that knocks far back
passive: Now and then the bell rings: rest, heal, speed up
ModReefChampion.vault: A mantis shrimp prizefighter. It fights in rounds and rests in its corner at the bell
